name: Electropeller
summary: In Darkshore, Wizbang Cranktoggle's electropellers lie scattered in freshwater rivers after a failed night outing.

sections.title: Mishaps along the Riverbank
sections.body: Wizbang Cranktoggle built the electropeller to propel an experimental exploding duck decoy. The gnome inventor works out of Auberdine. While scouting Darkshore's waterways after too many drinks, he blacked out. Hours later, he woke with singed hair and an empty pack. His electropellers had tumbled into Darkshore's freshwater currents, where they remain scattered through rivers and lakes until patient anglers recover them.

faq.q: What is an electropeller used for?
faq.answer: Wizbang Cranktoggle designed electropellers to propel an experimental, self-propelled, exploding duck decoy he was developing in Darkshore.

faq.q: How did these parts end up in the rivers of Darkshore?
faq.answer: While scouting Darkshore at night after too many drinks, Wizbang Cranktoggle blacked out. He woke hours later with singed hair and an empty pack; his electropellers had tumbled into the freshwater currents.
Anglers can recover electropellers from Darkshore's freshwater bodies, including the Cliffspring River and the Wildbend River.
Wizbang Cranktoggle, a gnome in Auberdine, wants twelve electropellers returned so he can continue his decoy research.

angles.text: For an engineer, the electropeller shows the ambition and hazards of gnomish engineering. Wizbang Cranktoggle designed it to propel an exploding duck decoy, but it ended up in the river before a proper test.
As a gnome, you may recognize Wizbang Cranktoggle's bold technical ambition. He asks passing anglers to salvage the results of his late-night experiments.
